## What changed

Describe the user-facing change and the primary journey it affects.

## Release confidence

- [ ] Automated accessibility and usability quality gate passes.
- [ ] Keyboard-only core journey checked.
- [ ] 200% and 400% zoom/reflow checked for changed screens.
- [ ] Loading, empty, success, validation, and service-error states checked.
- [ ] No dead links, buttons, controls, or navigation destinations introduced.

For major interaction or layout changes:

- [ ] VoiceOver with Safari journey completed and results recorded.
- [ ] NVDA with Chrome journey completed and results recorded.
- [ ] Any accessibility blockers have an owner and are resolved before release.

Use the full [accessibility and usability release checklist](../docs/accessibility-usability-release-checklist.md) for test details.
